metaDescription: Order custom unisex cooling sport towels for your team or event. Bulk pricing available. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Unisex cooling sport towels are designed to fit any athlete or worker, with a universal size that works for men and women alike. Made from high-performance microfiber, these towels activate with a simple soak and snap to provide hours of cooling relief. Whether you're outfitting a sports team, a construction crew, or a corporate wellness program, these towels offer a practical, gender-neutral option that keeps everyone comfortable. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or heat transfer for maximum brand visibility.
